pages.title: Combined Breath Effects
pages.text: Four accessories become one. Fire and ice breath is stronger and quicker; lightning breath is stronger and lasts longer.

pages.title: Crafting the Device
pages.text: Top: Lightning Discharge Device. Middle, left to right: Steaming Drink, Dragon Breath Emblem, Icy Drink.

pages.title: Compatible Dragon Types
pages.text: Fire, ice, and lightning dragons can all wear it, using one accessory slot. Make room for it before setting out.
